# ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops Daily Update (Jun 2, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on a critical bug fix for `MultisigTask` to tolerate negative gas refunds and the execution of several U19 betanet tasks on Sepolia. Discussions around `op-revm` support and interop transaction pool recovery were also prominent.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Multisig Task Robustness
A bug in `MultisigTask` was fixed to allow for negative per-call gas refunds during transaction simulation, preventing unnecessary failures. This improves the robustness of multisig operations. ([#1443](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1443))

### U19 Betanet Task Execution
Several U19 betanet tasks (086-089) related to permissioned and permissionless settings, dispute game implementation, and respected game types have been marked as EXECUTED on Sepolia, with links to their respective Etherscan transactions. ([#1444](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1444))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- [#1447](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1447) introduces a feature for U19 permissionless flip for karst-u19-alpha and a beta-0 correction for CANNON_KONA.
- [#1446](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1446) proposes a feature to double the gas target for OP Mainnet and OP Sepolia.
- [#1445](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1445) updates the U19 betanet prestate and sets a game arguments template.

## CLOSED ISSUES
No issues were closed today.

## NEW ISSUES
### Interop Transaction Pool Recovery Challenges
A new issue highlights that `op-reth`'s transaction pool does not resume accepting interop transactions after the `op-interop-filter` failsafe is disabled, requiring a restart of `op-reth`. ([#21149](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/21149))

### Invalid Interop Message Recovery
A runbook is needed to recover a chain after an invalid interop message triggers a reorg, as several systems do not smoothly handle such large reorgs. ([#21161](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/21161))

## ACTIVE ISSUES
### `op-revm` Support ([#21069](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/21069))
Discussions continue regarding the synchronization of `op-revm` with new `revm` releases. The team aims to stay in sync, potentially aligning updates with `reth` dependency bumps. There's particular interest in REVM's latest v111 release, which includes WIP support for the Amsterdam hardfork (EL) and refactors, allowing for shared type definitions between `op-revm` and other REVM crates.

### Spin up devnet ([#20691](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/20691))
The latest update indicates that a local devnet is now running, and the next step is to establish a long-running devnet. Previously, the plan was to wait for `glamsterdam-devnet-4` images before attempting a full devnet in the infrastructure.

### op-reth: interop tx pool does not resume after failsafe is disabled (requires restart) ([#21149](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/21149))
Further investigation revealed that restarting `op-reth` alone is insufficient to restore interop after clearing the failsafe. The `op-rbuilder` (flashblocks block builder) also needs to be restarted on the sequencers, along with `rollup-boost`, to fully restore interop functionality. A failsafe-state gauge metric is proposed in [#21151](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/21151) to improve observability of this state.

### Invalid interop message recovery runbook ([#21161](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/21161))
The discussion emphasizes the need for a comprehensive runbook to address the challenges of recovering from an invalid interop message that triggers a large reorg. The runbook should cover issues like [#21149](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/21149), [#20006](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/20006), and [#21125](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/21125), and ensure the failsafe is properly disabled.
